title: Small bias in dimension zero
statement: For any natural number $m$, any sample of $m$ elements of the zero-dimensional vector space over $\mathbb F_2$, and any real number $\varepsilon$, the sample is $\varepsilon$-biased: every nonzero vector frequency has empirical character mean of absolute value at most $\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: A sample of $m$ vectors in $\mathbb F_2^0$
